versions.changelog:
Initial release of crypto-gas-fee-optimizer:

- Fetches live gas prices from Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Polygon via free public RPC endpoints.
- Ranks chains by estimated USD transaction cost using live ETH/MATIC prices from CoinGecko.
- Offers one-call comparison and a general low-traffic timing note to help users pick cheaper chains or better transaction times.
- No API keys required; read-only and complementary to trading and DeFi tools.
- Useful for estimating costs before bridging, swapping, deploying contracts, or other on-chain actions.
